comments.text: Hi I bought some of this, I have spent lots of money in the past on eyelash serum and had bad results re the Prosterglandins. I have been using this now for 10 days, no sign of new growth but I have no doubt that within the month they will be thickening and length growth. comments.author: @beyond50skin
comments.text: I’ve used bimatoprost for quite a while & for a few years now have been alternating it with RevitaLash. Unlike many I have had very good results with bimatoprost. No noticeable side effects; but of course I don’t want to risk fat loss in the orbital area. Before I started using bimatoprost, about seven years ago, I had severely sunken eyes (age related ) which improved with a touch of filler and some PRF. My castor oil lash experiment didn’t last long.  For some reason my eyes became very irritated 🤷🏼‍♀️. Most recently, RevitaLash  has started to burn my eyes. I’m definitely interested in moving away from a prostaglandin based lash serums. I certainly don’t want to risk fat pad loss, if there’s a sum out there that can give similar benefits to bimatoprost / prostate Landon serums . My Reviv journey has just started!! I hope my results are as beautiful as yours. I had no luck with the ordinary serum 😢 either. I agree with you it’s all in the formulation. Thanks for this wonderful review.😊
